name: energy-shield-dome
title: Energy Shield Dome
author: KotoKi
description: A Fulgora-built shield generator that grows an energy dome over your base. The dome is a wall, not a turret: enemies and their acid cannot pass, your shots fly out freely. Deploying, holding and absorbing hits all cost power; if your grid cannot keep up, the dome collapses. An electric field zaps enemies just outside the edge.
